hypotheses.binder: (hθ : ∀ t : CuspForm.heckeAlgebra N 2 (↑S : Set ℕ), θ t = θ' (Subalgebra.inclusion (CuspForm.heckeAlgebra_mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr hS₀)) t))
hypotheses.justification: The proof never refers to `hθ` (the only other occurrences of that name are in `hθ'U`). The conclusion and the types of the remaining binders do not depend on it, so the existing proof establishes the same result after deleting this binder; no degenerate cases need separate treatment.
